claim.subject: αCD163/LNP-ZsGreen
claim.value: F4/80+ cells show higher ZsGreen-positive percentage than Desmin+ cells
visible_support: In panel L, the green bar for F4/80+ZsGreen is visibly taller than the green bar for Desmin+ZsGreen.
The caption states: 'K-L) IF images depicting the co-staining with markers for liver cells (ALB+), HSCs (Desmin+), macrophages (F4/80+)...'
In panel K, the merge image for DAPI/ZsGreen/F4/80 shows more ZsGreen signal overlapping with F4/80 compared to the Desmin channel.
